name: after-ci
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [ci]
    types: [completed]
jobs:
  report:
    runs-on:
      - self-hosted
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          run-id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
      - run: echo "${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch }}"
